hook.en: Sunlight lets you see, gives you a sunburn, and *X-rays* let a doctor see your bones. As the wavelength shrinks, the waves get more powerful.

say.en: Sunlight lets you see, gives you a sunburn, and X-rays let a doctor see your bones. As the wavelength shrinks, the waves get more powerful. In this lesson: Give the ranges, sources and uses of visible, UV, X-rays and gamma rays.
Identify a region from its wavelength or frequency.

body.en: *Visible* light (about 700 nm to 400 nm) is the narrow band our eyes detect. Ultraviolet (400 nm to about 0.6 nm) is produced by very hot bodies such as the Sun and by special lamps. The ozone layer absorbs most of it. UV is used in water purifiers to kill germs and in LASIK eye surgery; too much causes sunburn and skin cancer.
body.kn: ದೃಗ್ಗೋಚರ ಬೆಳಕು ಸುಮಾರು 400–700 nm. ನೇರಳಾತೀತ ಕಿರಣಗಳು ಸೂರ್ಯನಿಂದ ಬರುತ್ತವೆ; ಓಝೋನ್ ಪದರ ಅವನ್ನು ಹೀರುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀರು ಶುದ್ಧೀಕರಣ ಮತ್ತು LASIK ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ.

say.en: Visible light runs from about 400 nanometres, violet, to 700 nanometres, red.
Ultraviolet comes from the Sun and the ozone layer absorbs most of it. X-rays come when fast electrons hit a metal target; gamma rays come from nuclei.
Photon energy is h c by lambda, about 1240 electron-volt nanometre divided by the wavelength.
So green light of 500 nanometres carries 2.48 electron-volt, while a 0.1 nanometre X-ray carries 12.4 kilo-electron-volt.

explanation.en: Going from visible light to gamma rays the wavelength gets shorter and each photon carries more energy, so the radiation becomes more penetrating and more harmful to living cells.

body.en: X-rays (about 10 nm to $10^{-4}$ nm) are produced when fast electrons hit a metal target; they are used in medical imaging and to treat cancer. *Gamma rays*, the shortest waves, come from nuclear reactions and radioactive nuclei; they are used in medicine to destroy cancer cells.
body.kn: ವೇಗದ ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳು ಲೋಹದ ಗುರಿಗೆ ಬಡಿದಾಗ X-ಕಿರಣಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತವೆ; ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಚಿತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ. ಗಾಮಾ ಕಿರಣಗಳು ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್‌ನಿಂದ ಬರುತ್ತವೆ; ಕ್ಯಾನ್ಸರ್ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Radiation of frequency 1.5 times 10 to the power 15 hertz falls on a sample. Find its wavelength and the region of the spectrum.
lambda equals c over nu equals 3 times 10 to the power 8 divided by 1.5 times 10 to the power 15.
lambda equals 2 times 10 to the power minus 7 metres equals 200 nanometres.
200 nanometres is shorter than 400 nanometres, so it is ultraviolet.
So the answer is 200 nanometres, ultraviolet.
